compat.text: ▪ Neutral cure ▪ Excellent adhesion to most common construction materials such as: glass, enamel, ceramics, tiles, most metal*, most plastic, rubber, concrete and grouts ▪ Non-sag ▪ Easy tooling characteristics ▪ Mould resistance ▪ Fast curing ▪ Movement capability ±50% ▪ High temperature resistance (-40°c to +150°c) *Not for use on all metal and natural stone substrates i.e. copper. -See Important Considerations below prior to use.
compat.heading: FEATURES

compat.text: Do not use on natural stone.
compat.heading: IMPORTANT CONSIDERATIONS

compat.text: Do not use on bituminous substrates, natural rubber or any building materials which might leach oils, plasticisers or solvents that could degrade the sealant
compat.heading: IMPORTANT CONSIDERATIONS

compat.text: Do not use Davco® N Silicone in areas which are exposed to strong oxidising acids (e.g. nitric acid) and bases.
compat.heading: IMPORTANT CONSIDERATIONS

compat.text: Do not use to seal joints in or around swimming pools.
compat.heading: IMPORTANT CONSIDERATIONS

compat.text: Do not use for joints under water pressure or permanent water immersion.
compat.heading: IMPORTANT CONSIDERATIONS

compat.text: Do not use Davco® N Silicone in totally confined spaces as it requires atmospheric moisture to cure
compat.heading: IMPORTANT CONSIDERATIONS

compat.text: Do not use for medical or pharmaceutical applications.
compat.heading: IMPORTANT CONSIDERATIONS

compat.text: use a brush to apply Sika® Primer-3 N and allow a further flash-off time of > 30 minutes (< 8 hours) before sealing the joints
compat.heading: SUBSTRATE PREPARATION

compat.text: PVC has to be cleaned and pre-treated using Sika® Primer- 215 applied with a brush
compat.heading: SUBSTRATE PREPARATION

compat.text: Porous substrates Concrete, aerated concrete and cement based renders, mortars and bricks shall be primed using Sika® Primer-3 N applied with a brush
compat.heading: SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
